reference_policy: When a request carries an urgent tag and the alert source and affected service are verified, route directly to the on-call specialist; when a request carries an urgent tag but that verification is absent, send the request to the intake queue for verification.
task: A request carries an urgent tag after a user reports slow work. The record includes no verified alert source, and the user has not identified an affected service. What should the service desk do?
choices: [{"label": "A", "text": "route directly to the on-call specialist"}, {"label": "B", "text": "send the request to the intake queue for verification"}, {"label": "C", "text": "close the request as informational"}]
experience: The case involved An urgent-tagged request reported slow work from one user. No alert source was verified, and the service had not been identified.. The response was to send the request to the intake queue for verification, and afterwards Intake confirmed a local network issue and sent the request to workplace support rather than the service on-call rotation.

reference_policy: When an abstract reports a randomized trial, include the study in the evidence synthesis only if the full text confirms randomized allocation and the study population matches the review protocol; otherwise hold the study for full-text verification.

experience: During An abstract reported a randomized trial, and the full article was retrieved, but the methods section did not explain how allocation had been assigned., the agent chose to hold the study for full-text verification. The observed result was: The record remained pending until clarification was obtained, preventing an unsupported design label in the update.

reference_policy: When a run is marked completed and its ingestion audit confirms that all assigned events were ingested, publish the experiment results; when a completed run has missing, delayed, or unverified assigned events, reconcile the experiment data before publication.

reference_policy: When route synchronization reports a revision mismatch, apply the saved route configuration only when the route is inactive and the saved configuration matches the released service manifest; otherwise retrieve the live configuration and make a targeted reconciliation.

reference_policy: When a maintenance-window alert falls within an active approved work order for the exact alerted unit and scheduled time, suppress the alert until the next review interval; when a maintenance-window alert has no such matching work order, open a facilities investigation.

The observed result was: Facilities found a partially closed outside-air damper on Air Handler 4 and restored normal airflow.

reference_policy: When an input file has a checksum mismatch and the mirror copy is identified by a current signed manifest for the same delivery, replace the input file with the mirror copy; when the checksum mismatch lacks that verified mirror identity, quarantine the input file and request a verified resend.

experience: The case involved An input file had a checksum mismatch, and the mirror folder contained a copy with no signed manifest linking it to the delivery record.. The response was to replace the input file with the mirror copy, and afterwards The mirror copy validated successfully and the scheduled load completed.

Its release entry listed immutable digest sha256:8c1f, and the attached signed provenance record listed the identical digest. Action taken: promote the existing artifact to staging Observed outcome: Staging received the recorded artifact, and the deployment receipt matched the release entry.

reference_policy: When a replication alarm is active, force a failover to the replica only when the replica is verified at zero lag and a recorded failover authorization is present; otherwise place the service in read-only mode.
task: The reporting service has an active replication alarm. The replica is reporting five minutes of lag, and the change record has no failover authorization. Should the operator force a failover to the replica, place the service in read-only mode, or silence the replication alarm?
choices: [{"label": "A", "text": "force a failover to the replica"}, {"label": "B", "text": "place the service in read-only mode"}, {"label": "C", "text": "silence the replication alarm"}]
experience: During A replication alarm was active during month-end report generation. The replica was 70 seconds behind the primary, while the change record did authorize a possible transition., the agent chose to place the service in read-only mode. The observed result was: Write requests were held while reports remained readable, and the replica caught up before a later authorized transition.

reference_policy: When a catalog search returns zero results and a completed coverage report shows that the requested collection is indexed, broaden the query; when zero results occur without that coverage confirmation, check index coverage before changing the query.

The available coverage record belonged to an archived repository rather than the active procedure library.. The response was to check index coverage before changing the query, and afterwards The coverage review identified the repository mismatch and directed the search to the active library.

Decision — retrieve the current record and reconcile the fields Result — Reconciliation routed the discrepancy for source confirmation and prevented an unsupported status change.

reference_policy: When a migration command timed out and the migration journal explicitly records that the transaction rolled back, rerun the migration; when the command timed out without that rollback record, reconcile the schema and migration journal.

Should the operator rerun the migration, reconcile the schema and migration journal, or restore the database from the previous backup?
choices: [{"label": "A", "text": "restore the database from the previous backup"}, {"label": "B", "text": "rerun the migration"}, {"label": "C", "text": "reconcile the schema and migration journal"}]

The journal contained neither a rollback nor a completion record, and the backfill was not safe to apply twice. Decision — reconcile the schema and migration journal Result — State reconciliation identified a partially applied backfill, allowing the team to complete the remaining rows without duplicating updates.
